title: mymind
description: Quiet, private and warm: white pages with blush and warm-grey bands, a vivid tangerine for buttons and one full-bleed band, pastel feature cards (beige, mist blue, sage, blush, peach), and soft orange-to-pink light around a white disc. An oldstyle book serif for big tight headlines and long manifesto text, a neutral grotesk for reading, a rounded sans for pills, buttons and small capitals.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a warm-black sibling that keeps the tangerine and the pastel tones as dim tints
Newsreader stands in for the original's display serif (Louize, closed); Inter is the original's own body face; Nunito is the original's own rounded UI face
sets --mymind-round (Nunito) for buttons, pills and small capitals; mymind blocks fall back to the body face under other themes
